name: Rooms Maze (Diablo-style dungeon w/ spawners + chests)
description: Rogue rooms+tunnels generator: large rooms tagged Trash/Elite/Boss/Treasure/Empty, connected by L-tunnels, walled with stone (0x008E), floored with marble (0x0513), decorated with bones/web/torches/etc., and accompanied by a Data/Spawns/rooms-maze-<seed>.json spawner file loaded via ModernUO's [ImportSpawners command. Pair with paint-rooms-maze.ps1 + make-rooms-maze.bat. Default scope 512x512 produces ~14 rooms (forced ≥1 Boss + ≥1 Treasure).
